label: dangerous
reason:
- The URL uses a look‑alike domain “www.roblox.com.et”, which adds the extra “.com.et” suffix to the legitimate “roblox.com” brand, a classic phishing pattern.  
- Multiple security vendors flag this domain as malicious, with many labeling it as phishing.  
- The page loads the majority of its images, scripts, and stylesheets from the real Roblox CDN (js.rbxcdn.com), indicating that the site is hotlinking assets from the genuine service while presenting a fake host.  
- The login link and form actions point back to the same suspicious domain rather than the official “roblox.com”, attempting to capture credentials on a counterfeit site.  
- No legitimate registration information is available for the domain, and the WHOIS data does not reveal a trustworthy age, further weakening its credibility.

label: dangerous
reason:
- The URL uses the brand name “roblox” inside a longer domain “roblox.com.bi”, which is not the official Roblox domain (roblox.com). This pattern of embedding a well‑known brand in a different top‑level domain is a classic phishing indicator.  
- Security analysis shows that 20 different security vendors have flagged this domain as malicious, with many labeling it specifically as a phishing site.  
- The WHOIS record for the parent domain was created only 158 days ago, and the subdomain itself is unregistered, indicating a very recent and likely throw‑away site.  
- Although the page loads many assets (scripts, stylesheets, images) from Roblox’s legitimate CDN, the page itself is served from the suspicious host, a common tactic to make a cloned page appear authentic while controlling the landing domain.  
- The page contains a form that posts to the same suspicious domain (https://www.roblox.com.bi/search) and offers “Log In” links that redirect to the fake domain, which could be used to harvest credentials.  
- The overall combination of brand impersonation, recent registration, multiple vendor detections, and credential‑collecting elements makes this site a clear phishing threat.
